AWL Agri Business.desc: Formerly Adani Wilmar, AWL is India's largest branded edible-oil company (Fortune brand) and a growing food-staples business with wheat flour, rice, pulses, sugar and ready-to-cook lines. Post the Adani Enterprises stake sale to Wilmar International, the business is positioned as a pure-play branded-foods franchise. Distribution reaches over 1 million retail outlets across urban and rural India.

Adani Power.desc: India's largest private-sector thermal power generator. Operates roughly 18 GW of coal-fired capacity across Mundra, Tiroda, Kawai, Udupi, Raipur and Mahan, with a roadmap to ~31 GW by FY30 backed by recent capacity acquisitions. Part of the Adani Group; capacity is largely tied up under long-term PPAs with state distribution utilities.

Aditya Birla Capital.desc: Financial-services holding arm of the Aditya Birla Group, anchored by promoter Grasim Industries. The lending business (Aditya Birla Finance) is a diversified NBFC spanning retail, SME, housing and corporate loans, while the asset-management arm (Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, separately listed) is a top-five Indian mutual fund. Other operating subsidiaries include life insurance, health insurance and stock broking, distributed through a pan-India branch and partner network alongside the group's digital platform.

Afcons Infrastructure.desc: Flagship infrastructure-EPC arm of the Shapoorji Pallonji group. Executes marine, urban-metro, hydro, oil & gas, surface-transport and underground projects across India, the Middle East, Africa and South Asia. Known for complex technically-differentiated jobs — sea-link bridges, large-diameter tunnels and hydro caverns.

Amber Enterprises.desc: India's largest room-AC contract manufacturer, supplying finished air-conditioners and components to Voltas, Daikin, LG, Samsung, Whirlpool and most other major brands. Diversified into electronics manufacturing services (PCBA) via Sidwal and into railway air-conditioning sub-systems via ILJIN.

Anthem Biosciences.desc: Bangalore-based contract research, development and manufacturing organisation (CRDMO). Serves global innovator pharma and biotech with small molecules, peptides, biologics and fermentation chemistry across the discovery, development and commercial-manufacturing continuum. Recently IPO-listed.

Astral.desc: India's #2 CPVC and PVC plumbing-pipes brand. Expanded from pipes into adhesives (Resinova), paints, water tanks, valves and bath-ware to evolve into a broader building-materials platform with a pan-India dealer network.

Avalon Technologies.desc: Vertically-integrated electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company with manufacturing in India and the US. Focuses on box-build assembly for power, semiconductor, clean-energy, medical and aerospace OEMs — among the few Indian EMS players with a US footprint.

Avenue Supermarts.desc: Operator of the DMart value-retail chain — India's most efficient hypermarket format with the lowest cost-to-serve in listed retail. Stores carry food, non-food groceries, general merchandise and apparel at deep-discount prices through an everyday-low-price model; cluster-based store expansion prioritises profitability over headline growth.

Bajaj Finserv.desc: Holding company of the Bajaj group's financial-services franchise. Subsidiaries include Bajaj Finance (consumer and SME lending), Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance, Bajaj Allianz General Insurance, and newer ventures in payments, broking and asset management.

Bharat Electronics.desc: Government-owned defence-electronics PSU. India's largest indigenous supplier of radars, communication systems, electronic-warfare suites, missile-system electronics and sonar / underwater electronics, with growing exposure to civilian segments (homeland security, space, semiconductor packaging, civil aviation).

Bharat Petroleum.desc: India's second-largest oil-marketing company. Roughly 16% retail-fuel market share across 23,000+ outlets; refining capacity of ~38 mmtpa at Mumbai, Kochi and Bina. Also operates a cross-country pipeline network, an LPG bottling and distribution business, and is building out a petrochemical complex at Bina.

CMS Info Systems.desc: India's largest cash-management company. Provides ATM cash-replenishment, cash-in-transit, retail cash management and managed services for banks, plus brown-label ATM operations. Expanding into adjacent BFSI technology after acquiring FSS.

Carborundum Universal.desc: Murugappa-group leader in abrasives, ceramics and electro-minerals. Key supplier to automotive, infrastructure, energy and electronics OEMs in India and globally, with international subsidiaries in Russia, South Africa and the US.

Chalet Hotels.desc: K Raheja-promoted luxury and upscale hotel chain. Operates Marriott, Westin, JW Marriott, Renaissance and Hyatt Regency-branded properties in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune, alongside a commercial real-estate annuity portfolio.

Coforge.desc: Midcap IT services exporter with deep verticals in banking & financial services, travel & transportation, and insurance. Acquired Cigniti to build a quality-engineering and AI competency at scale; markets the Quasar AI-platform for large enterprise transformation.

Deepak Nitrite.desc: Integrated specialty-chemicals producer. Operates India's only large-scale phenol-acetone complex at Dahej, plus performance chemicals, fuel additives, IPA, fluorination chemistry and a polycarbonate joint venture.

Delhivery.desc: India's largest integrated logistics-tech company. Services include express parcel, part-truckload, full-truckload, supply-chain services and cross-border for e-commerce, D2C and SME shippers. Consolidated the parcel-logistics market after acquiring Ecom Express.

Devyani International.desc: India's largest QSR franchisee. Operates KFC, Pizza Hut and Costa Coffee stores in India, Nepal, Nigeria and select other geographies under master-franchise agreements with Yum! Brands and Costa.

Fusion Finance.desc: Microfinance NBFC with operations across 22 Indian states. Provides small-ticket unsecured loans to rural and semi-urban women borrowers organised in joint-liability groups.

GE Vernova T&D India.desc: Indian subsidiary of GE Vernova's grid-solutions business. Manufactures power transformers, high-voltage substations, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), HVDC and FACTS systems for PGCIL, state utilities and private generators across India and select export markets.

Gland Pharma.desc: India's largest pure-play generic-injectables exporter. Supplies sterile injectables, contract-development and contract-manufacturing services to the US, EU, Canada, Australia and emerging markets. Acquired Cenexi (France) for European sterile-fill capacity.

Global Health (Medanta).desc: Operator of the Medanta hospitals network — among India's leading tertiary and quaternary care chains. Anchor units in Gurugram, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Noida with strong programmes in oncology, cardiology and organ transplantation.

Hindalco.desc: Aditya Birla group's flagship metals company. India's largest aluminium and copper producer, plus the global Novelis platform in flat-rolled aluminium products serving auto, packaging and aerospace end-markets.

Hindustan Aeronautics.desc: India's largest aerospace and defence PSU. Designs and manufactures fighter aircraft (Tejas LCA), helicopters (LCH, ALH, LUH), engines, avionics and MRO services primarily for the Indian Air Force, Army and Navy.

ICICI Prudential Life Insurance.desc: Joint venture between ICICI Bank and Prudential PLC. Among India's largest private life insurers, with a balanced product mix across ULIPs, protection, annuity, non-par savings and group business.

ITC Hotels.desc: ITC's hotels business demerged into a separate listing. Luxury and upper-upscale chain with the ITC Grand, ITC Royal, WelcomHotel, Mementos, Storii and Fortune brands across 140+ properties in India and select overseas markets.

India Macro.desc: Sector notebook covering India macro indicators — CPI, IIP, GDP, fiscal deficit, RBI policy, currency, oil & commodity exposure. Aggregates broker views, RBI/MoSPI releases and the IMF/IFS macro feed used in the News tab snapshot.

India Strategy.desc: Sector notebook collating India-strategy reports from broker research houses — quarterly earnings dissectors, sector rotation calls, model-portfolio changes and valuation frameworks.

Indian Banks.desc: Sector notebook on Indian banking — large private banks (HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak), PSU banks, asset-quality cycle, NIM trajectory, deposit competition and loan-growth mix across retail, SME and corporate.

Indian Cement.desc: Sector notebook on Indian cement — Big-5 consolidation (UltraTech, Ambuja-ACC, Shree, Dalmia, JK), pricing discipline, regional supply-demand, infra/housing demand drivers and clinker capacity additions.

Indian Financials.desc: Sector notebook for India financials — banks, NBFCs, life and general insurance, asset-management and capital-markets businesses. Tracks system credit growth, deposit-LDR dynamics and the BFSI monthly indicators.

Indian Hotels.desc: IHCL is the Tata Group's listed hospitality company. Operates the Taj, SeleQtions, Vivanta, Ginger and Tree of Life brands across 200+ properties in India and key gateway markets, with a long pipeline of asset-light managed openings.

Indian IT.desc: Sector notebook on Indian IT services — Tier-1 (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Tech Mahindra), Tier-2 (Coforge, Persistent, LTIMindtree, Mphasis, LTTS, Cyient) and the discretionary-spend / AI-led-transformation cycle.

Indian Jewellery.desc: Sector notebook on Indian organised jewellery — Titan/Tanishq, Kalyan, Senco, PNG, Joyalukkas — covering gold price cycle, hallmarking regulation, store expansion and the unorganised-to-organised market-share shift.

Indian Oil Corporation.desc: India's largest oil-marketing and refining company. ~30% market share in fuels retail, ~80 mmtpa refining capacity and an extensive cross-country pipeline network. Diversifying into petrochemicals (Paradip), green hydrogen and gas pipelines.

Indian Pharmaceuticals.desc: Sector notebook for Indian pharma — generic exporters (Sun, Cipla, Lupin, Aurobindo, Dr Reddy's, Zydus), domestic-formulations leaders (Mankind, Torrent, Alkem) and CDMO/CRO names. Tracks USFDA inspection cadence, GxMeter pricing and India MAT growth.

Indian Steel.desc: Sector notebook on Indian steel — Tata Steel, JSW Steel, SAIL, Jindal Steel & Power, plus regional players. Tracks HRC pricing, coking-coal cycle, capacity additions and import/export dynamics.

Indraprastha Gas.desc: Delhi-NCR's leading city-gas-distribution company. Supplies CNG to vehicles and PNG to households, commercial and industrial customers across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Karnal and Rewari.

JSW Energy.desc: JSW Group's integrated power utility. Operates coal, hydro, solar and wind capacity, and is building a battery-storage and green-hydrogen portfolio. Expansion is via both organic build-out and renewable-asset acquisitions.

KEC International.desc: RPG-group flagship EPC contractor. Builds power-transmission lines, substations, railways, civil structures, cables and oil & gas pipelines across India, the Middle East, Africa and the Americas.

KIMS.desc: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences — South India's leading multi-specialty hospital chain. Anchored in Hyderabad with a growing presence in Kerala, Karnataka and Maharashtra through greenfield and brownfield additions.

MakeMyTrip.desc: India's largest online travel agency. Operates the MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and redBus platforms covering flights, hotels, holidays, bus and rail bookings. NASDAQ-listed.

Mankind Pharma.desc: India's #4 pharma company by domestic prescriptions. Strongest in chronic therapies (cardiac, anti-diabetic, anti-infective) alongside mass-market consumer brands such as Manforce, Prega News and Gas-O-Fast. The Bharat Serums acquisition added a women's health and critical-care portfolio.

NHPC.desc: India's largest hydro-power generator. Central PSU operating ~8 GW across 24 hydro stations with another 4-5 GW under construction (including the Parbati-II and Subansiri-Lower projects). Diversifying into solar, BESS and green hydrogen via the NHPC Renewable Energy subsidiary.

Nagarjuna.desc: Hyderabad-based mid-cap EPC contractor (NCC Ltd). Executes buildings, transport, electrical, irrigation, water and metals projects across India.

Neogen Chemicals.desc: India's largest bromine-based specialty-chemicals producer. Has a growing organo-lithium and electrolyte-additives portfolio targeting lithium-ion battery supply chains, supported by a multi-year capex programme for downstream battery materials.

Orkla India.desc: Indian arm of Norway's Orkla group. Owns MTR Foods (South Indian ready-meals, spices), Eastern Condiments and Rasoi Magic. Recently IPO-listed; growth strategy is premium South Indian foods plus exports to the diaspora.

Power Grid.desc: State-owned monopoly transmission utility. Operates ~178,000 ckm of EHV lines as India's central transmission system, alongside consultancy and a growing telecom-tower leasing business.

Premier Energies.desc: Hyderabad-based integrated solar manufacturer. Produces cells, modules and EPC services with ~5 GW module / 2 GW cell capacity (expanding toward ~10/5 GW). Beneficiary of India's PLI programme and ALMM/DCR domestic-content requirements.

ReNew.desc: US-listed independent power producer. India's largest by operating renewable capacity (>10 GW utility-scale wind and solar) with growing solar-PV manufacturing and a commercial & industrial (C&I) business.

Restaurant Brands Asia.desc: Master franchisee of Burger King in India and Indonesia. Currently extending the brand portfolio into Popeyes (premium chicken QSR).

S H Kelkar and Company.desc: India's leading domestic fragrance and flavour producer. Serves FMCG, personal-care and home-care customers across India and ~50 export markets.

SJVN.desc: Central PSU operating ~2.1 GW of hydro power across Himachal Pradesh, Bhutan and Nepal. Expanding into thermal, solar, wind and pumped-storage with a ~25 GW capacity target.

Siemens Energy India.desc: Demerged Siemens India energy business. Manufactures high-voltage T&D equipment, gas turbines, generators and digital-grid solutions for utilities and industrial customers in India and select export markets.

Steel Authority of India.desc: India's largest steel PSU. Integrated plants at Bhilai, Bokaro, Rourkela, Durgapur and IISCO, plus special-steels plants — combined hot-metal capacity of ~20 mmtpa.

TCS.desc: Tata Consultancy Services — India's largest IT exporter and a top-3 global IT services firm. Provides application services, consulting, cloud, AI, infrastructure and BPS services to clients in 50+ countries, with deep verticals in banking, retail, manufacturing and life sciences.

Tata Steel.desc: Tata group's integrated steelmaker. India operations (~21 mmtpa) anchored at Jamshedpur and Kalinganagar; Europe operations include Netherlands (~7 mmtpa) and the UK (transitioning to EAF). Owns captive iron-ore and coal mining, downstream-products and the European long-products business.

Timken.desc: Indian subsidiary of US Timken Co. Supplies tapered roller, cylindrical and spherical bearings to railways (LHB coaches, Vande Bharat), trucks, off-highway equipment and process industries.

United Spirits.desc: Diageo India's listed spirits business. Owns Royal Challenge, Signature and McDowell's, and distributes Johnnie Walker and other Diageo brands locally. India's largest spirits company by volume and revenue.

Uno Minda.desc: Tier-1 auto-components supplier. Products span switches, lighting, horns, EV power-electronics (drive-units, BMS, motors), seat assemblies and infotainment for OEMs in India and globally.

Vodafone Idea.desc: India's #3 wireless operator (~22% revenue share). Backed by the Aditya Birla group and Vodafone PLC; offers 2G/4G voice and data services with limited 5G presence.

Zee Entertainment.desc: India's largest listed broadcaster. Operates the Zee TV linear network across Hindi general entertainment and regional languages, alongside the Zee5 streaming platform.

Zydus Lifesciences.desc: Ahmedabad-based generic pharma. Large US generics business and growing domestic-formulations franchise, with biosimilars, vaccines (via Zydus Wellness consumer-healthcare arm) and an emerging NCE pipeline.

Adani Enterprises.desc: Flagship and incubator of the Adani Group. Houses the integrated resources business (coal trading, mining services, mine developer) and the group's emerging ventures — airports, road infrastructure, data centres, solar manufacturing, green hydrogen, copper, defence and FMCG (Adani Wilmar's residual). Successful businesses are typically demerged into separately listed group companies.

Adani Ports and SEZ.desc: India's largest private-sector port operator. Operates a network of 14+ ports along the Indian coastline — anchored by Mundra — handling containers, dry bulk, liquid bulk and crude. Also runs a port-led logistics platform spanning warehousing, rail-haulage and inland container depots.

Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail.desc: Aditya Birla Group's apparel and lifestyle retail platform. Brand portfolio spans Madura Fashion menswear (Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, Peter England), value/large-format Pantaloons, the TCNS-acquired women's-wear stable (W, Aurelia, Wishful) and licensed brands (Reebok, Hackett, American Eagle). Distributed through exclusive-brand stores, large-format Pantaloons outlets and multi-brand departmental stores.

Aegis Logistics.desc: Liquid-logistics specialist. Owns and operates LPG and petrochemical storage terminals at key Indian ports along with an LPG sourcing and distribution business; expanding into ammonia handling and other green-fuel intermediates.

AIA Engineering.desc: Among the world's leading manufacturers of high-chrome mill internals — grinding media and mill liners — used in cement, mining and thermal-power grinding circuits. Ahmedabad-based; exports drive the bulk of revenue with replacement-cycle wear consumables as the recurring annuity.

Alkem Laboratories.desc: Top-five domestic-formulation pharma company anchored by anti-infectives. Big-brand franchises include Clavam, Taxim-O and Pan in anti-infectives and gastro, plus chronic-therapy build-out across cardiology, diabetology and neuropsychiatry. Also has a US generics business led by oral solids.

Amara Raja Energy and Mobility.desc: India's #2 lead-acid battery maker, selling under the Amaron and PowerZone brands across automotive, industrial (UPS, telecom) and home-inverter segments. Building out a new-energy vertical anchored by a lithium-ion cell and pack manufacturing platform plus EV-charging infrastructure.

Apar Industries.desc: Diversified electrical-engineering company. India's largest conductor manufacturer (overhead transmission), the largest domestic producer of specialty oils (transformer oils, industrial lubricants) and a growing power & telecom cables business; global supplier to T&D utilities and OEMs.

Apollo Hospitals.desc: India's largest private hospital chain. Operates 70+ hospitals with strong tertiary-care programmes in cardiology, oncology, organ transplants and neurosciences; complementary businesses include Apollo Pharmacies (retail), Apollo HealthCo (digital health, diagnostics and online pharmacy) and Apollo 24|7 telehealth.

Ashok Leyland.desc: Hinduja Group's commercial-vehicle flagship. India's #2 medium- and heavy-commercial-vehicle manufacturer with a growing light-CV and bus portfolio; defence mobility platforms (Stallion family) and the Switch Mobility electric-bus/LCV subsidiary build out the next-generation product slate.

Asian Paints.desc: India's largest paint company by a wide margin. Decorative-paints leader through Royale, Apex, Apcolite and Tractor; growing exposure in industrial paints, automotive coatings and waterproofing; recently expanded into home décor adjacencies (kitchen, bath, lighting). Anchored by a dense dealer network and category-defining brand equity.

ASK Automotive.desc: Auto-components supplier specialising in advanced two-wheeler braking (drum brakes, disc-brake calipers), aluminium light-weighting precision parts and wheel-assembly components. Customer base spans Hero MotoCorp, Bajaj Auto, TVS, Honda Motorcycle and Royal Enfield.

Ather Energy.desc: Bengaluru-based electric two-wheeler manufacturer. Designs and builds connected electric scooters — the Ather 450 family and family-oriented Ather Rizta — and runs the Ather Grid fast-charging network. Hero MotoCorp is the anchor strategic shareholder alongside the founders.

Aurobindo Pharma.desc: Vertically-integrated generics pharma spanning APIs, formulations and biosimilars. Large US generics franchise (oral solids and injectables) plus growing Europe and emerging-market exposure; expanding into biosimilars and vaccines through subsidiary CuraTeQ Biologics.

Bajaj Finance.desc: India's largest non-bank lender. Diversified retail and SME loan book spanning consumer durables, two-wheeler, lifestyle, EMI cards, personal loans and SME lending, complemented by home loans via Bajaj Housing Finance. Anchor lending business of the Bajaj Finserv platform with a large captive customer franchise.

Belrise Industries.desc: Auto-components supplier to two-wheeler and four-wheeler OEMs. Manufactures chassis and metal components, polymer assemblies, suspension parts and seating systems; recently listed.

Blue Jet Healthcare.desc: Pharma intermediates and contrast-media manufacturer. Among the global suppliers of iodinated contrast media (for diagnostic imaging) and high-intensity sweeteners (saccharin), with a growing pharma-intermediates franchise serving innovator clients.

BrainBees Solutions.desc: Operator of FirstCry, India's largest kidswear and baby-care omnichannel retailer. Online plus 1,000+ stores, own brands (BabyHug) and partner brands; also owns the BabyChakra D2C platform and runs the GlobalBees house-of-brands roll-up.

Britannia Industries.desc: Wadia Group's branded foods company. India's biggest biscuit maker — Good Day, NutriChoice, Milk Bikis, Marie Gold, Tiger, Treat, Bourbon — with growing adjacencies across dairy, breads, cakes, rusks, salty snacks and croissants.

Campus Activewear.desc: Branded sports and athleisure footwear specialist. Sells across multi-brand outlets, exclusive-brand stores and e-commerce with a value-for-money sneaker focus; aggressive D2C and own-store rollout.

Cartrade Tech.desc: Auto classifieds and remarketing platform. Operates CarTrade, CarWale and BikeWale on the consumer-facing side; Adroit Inspection (used-vehicle inspection services) and Shriram Automall (B2B used-vehicle auctions and physical yards) on the B2B side.

CEAT.desc: RPG Group tyre manufacturer. Makes truck-bus, passenger-car, two-wheeler, off-road and farm tyres for the Indian market plus exports; replacement-led brand strategy alongside a growing OEM-fitment business.

Cello World.desc: Branded consumer-housewares company. Plastic and steel kitchenware, glassware (Cello Opalware), insulated water bottles, lunch boxes and writing instruments (Cello pens); pan-India distribution plus a growing premium portfolio.

Colgate-Palmolive (India).desc: Indian subsidiary of Colgate-Palmolive (US). Market leader in oral care — toothpastes (Colgate Strong Teeth, Total, MaxFresh, Visible White, Vedshakti) and toothbrushes — and a smaller personal-care portfolio under the Palmolive masterbrand.

Concord Biotech.desc: Fermentation-based API specialist. Among the global leaders in immunosuppressant APIs (tacrolimus, cyclosporine, mycophenolate, sirolimus) plus oncology fermentation products; expanding into formulations and partnered finished dosage forms.

Container Corporation of India.desc: Government-owned (Ministry of Railways) container train operator. India's largest rail-based container logistics platform with own container terminals, inland container depots and rolling stock; also offers cross-border movement to Bangladesh and Nepal.

Cummins India.desc: Indian subsidiary of Cummins Inc. Manufactures diesel and natural-gas engines, gensets and power-generation systems for industrial, automotive and stationary applications; also distributes filtration, after-treatment and exhaust products.

Cyient.desc: IT services and engineering R&D company. Provides digital engineering and product-development services to aerospace, transportation, medical-devices, semiconductor, energy and utilities clients; the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing IDM business has been spun off into separately listed Cyient DLM.

Dabur India.desc: Diversified consumer-goods company anchored in Ayurveda. Big brands span hair care (Vatika, Dabur Amla, Brahmi Amla), oral care (Dabur Red, Meswak), foods and beverages (Real fruit juices, Hommade), home care (Odonil, Odomos) and OTC healthcare (Chyawanprash, Honitus, Lal Tail, Pudin Hara). Among the deepest rural distribution networks in Indian FMCG.

Dalmia Bharat.desc: India's fourth-largest cement producer. Capacity concentrated in East, South and North-East India, sold under the Dalmia Cement and Konark brands; high blended-cement share and an early-mover focus on the net-zero transition.

Dish TV.desc: Direct-to-Home (DTH) TV broadcaster. Operates the Dish TV and D2H brands; structurally challenged as Indian households shift to OTT and broadband-delivered video.

Divi's Laboratories.desc: Hyderabad-based API and custom-synthesis specialist. Among the world's top producers of generic APIs and a major partner for global innovators on patented intermediates; building out nutraceutical ingredients and contrast-media intermediates.

Eicher Motors.desc: Owner of Royal Enfield — the market-leading mid-size motorcycle brand — and a 50/50 JV partner in Volvo Eicher Commercial Vehicles (trucks and buses). Strong brand-led pricing power in the global middleweight motorcycle segment.

Emami.desc: Branded personal-care and ayurvedic-OTC company. Anchor brands include Boroplus antiseptic cream, Navratna cooling oil, Smart & Handsome men's grooming, Zandu (ayurvedic OTC) and Kesh King (hair oils and shampoos). Positioned in the masstige segment.

Entero Healthcare.desc: Pan-India pharma-distribution platform. Aggregates regional pharma distributors into a single supply-chain network serving pharmacies and hospitals; classic consolidator play in a highly fragmented industry.

EPL.desc: World's largest manufacturer of laminated and extruded plastic tubes (the former Essel Propack). Supplies tube packaging to global FMCG customers across oral care, beauty/cosmetics, pharma, food and home care, with plants spread across India, the Americas, Europe and Asia.

Eureka Forbes.desc: Home and lifestyle solutions company. Owns Aquaguard (water purifiers — category creator), Forbes vacuum cleaners and Euroclean home-cleaning products; controlled by Advent International since 2022.

Finolex Cables.desc: India's #2 electrical cables and wires brand. Power, communication and infrastructure cables anchor revenue, complemented by a growing electrical-consumer-goods portfolio (switches, fans, lighting, water heaters) under the Finolex name.

Finolex Industries.desc: India's #2 PVC pipes brand for agriculture and plumbing — the only major Indian pipe maker that is backward-integrated into PVC resin. Distribution reaches deep into rural irrigation belts alongside the urban plumbing channel.

Fortis Healthcare.desc: IHH-Healthcare-controlled Indian hospital chain. Operates ~28 hospitals across India and Sri Lanka with strong cardiac sciences, orthopaedics, neurology and oncology programmes; SRL Diagnostics is a major contributor to the integrated diagnostics business.

FSN E-commerce Ventures.desc: Operator of Nykaa — India's leading beauty and personal-care omnichannel retailer. Sells through Nykaa.com, Nykaa Fashion and 200+ physical stores, supported by own brands (Nykaa Cosmetics, Nykaa Naturals, KAY Beauty, Twenty Dresses) alongside the marquee global brand catalogue.

GAIL India.desc: India's largest natural-gas transmission and marketing company (government-owned). Operates the country's largest gas-pipeline network plus petrochemicals (Pata), LPG production and city-gas distribution joint ventures; central to India's gas-economy build-out.

General Insurance Corp of India.desc: Government-owned reinsurer. India's #1 reinsurance company providing capacity to domestic non-life insurers across fire, motor, marine, agriculture, engineering and life-treaty business, with growing inward international writings.

GMR Airports.desc: Airport operator. Runs Delhi (DIAL), Hyderabad (GHIAL) and Goa Mopa airports plus international assets (Cebu in the Philippines, Crete in Greece, Medan in Indonesia in development); also developing airport-led commercial real estate and aero-mall infrastructure.

Godrej Consumer Products.desc: Godrej Group's branded FMCG flagship. Strong franchises in home insecticides (Good Knight, HIT), hair colour (Godrej Expert), air-care (AER), liquid detergent (Ezee) and personal wash (Cinthol, Godrej No. 1). Sizeable international exposure to Indonesia and Africa.

Grasim Industries.desc: Aditya Birla Group's diversified manufacturing holding. Anchored by viscose-staple-fibre (one of the world's largest producers) and chemicals (caustic soda, chlor-alkali); also the holding entity for UltraTech Cement (listed separately) and the new Birla Opus decorative-paints venture.

Gujarat Gas.desc: Gujarat-government-owned city-gas-distribution company. India's largest CGD operator by volume — Surat, Vadodara, Ahmedabad Rural and 40+ other geographical areas — selling PNG (industrial, commercial, domestic) and CNG.

Gujarat Pipavav Port.desc: APM-Terminals-operated multi-cargo port on Gujarat's west coast. Handles containers, dry bulk, liquid bulk and roll-on/roll-off cargo; strong dedicated-rail connectivity to North and Central India hinterlands.

Hitachi Energy India.desc: Indian subsidiary of Hitachi Energy (Switzerland). Power-grid equipment and solutions — transformers, HVDC, gas-insulated switchgear, FACTS systems and grid-automation — supplied to PGCIL, state utilities and private grid developers.

Honasa Consumer.desc: Direct-to-consumer beauty and personal-care company. Anchor brand Mamaearth (toxin-free baby and personal care); house of brands extends into The Derma Co., Aqualogica, BBLUNT (haircare), Dr Sheth's and Ayuga.

Hyundai Motor India.desc: Indian subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Company (Korea). India's #2 passenger-vehicle manufacturer, with strong franchises in SUVs (Creta, Venue, Alcazar, Tucson) and hatchbacks (i20, Exter, Grand i10 Nios); first major automotive OEM IPO in India since Maruti.

ICRA.desc: Credit-ratings and research company. Moody's-affiliated; rates corporate debt, structured-finance instruments, banks, insurers and SMEs in India. ICRA Analytics provides knowledge-services, risk and outsourcing solutions.

IndiGo.desc: Operated by InterGlobe Aviation. India's #1 airline with ~60% domestic market share; low-cost carrier with a point-to-point Airbus A320/A321 backbone and ATR turboprops for regional routes; rapidly expanding internationally across the Middle East, ASEAN, Central Asia and Europe.

Indigo Paints.desc: India's #5 decorative-paints brand. Differentiated portfolio anchored by category-creator products (Metallic Emulsions, Tile-Coat Emulsion, Bright Ceiling Coat) alongside the regular emulsion and enamel range; growing dealer network in Tier-3/4 towns.

Indus Towers.desc: India's largest passive-infrastructure tower company. Owns and leases ~225,000 telecom towers to Indian wireless operators (Bharti Airtel, Vodafone Idea, Reliance Jio); created from the Indus + Bharti Infratel merger.

Info Edge.desc: Internet platforms holding company. Owns Naukri.com (#1 jobs portal), 99acres (real estate), Jeevansathi (matrimony), Shiksha (higher-education) and a portfolio of internet investments — including a major stake in Zomato (separately listed).

InterGlobe Aviation.desc: Operator of IndiGo, India's largest airline. Low-cost-carrier model with a point-to-point Airbus A320/A321 fleet plus ATR turboprops; ~60% domestic market share and a rapidly expanding international network.

International Gemmological Institute.desc: Global diamond, gemstone and jewellery certification lab. Operates ~30 labs across 10+ countries; long-standing certification standards for natural and lab-grown diamonds, coloured stones and finished jewellery; among the world's top three gem labs.

IPCA Laboratories.desc: Formulations and API pharma company. Strong franchise in anti-malarials (artemether-lumefantrine combinations), pain management (NSAIDs) and cardiovascular generics; revenue mix spans India, emerging markets, the UK (Unichem-acquired plants) and tender business.

IRB Infrastructure.desc: Toll-roads and highways operator. Builds, operates and tolls BOT highways across India through IRB and the listed IRB InvIT (private InvIT for cash-flow recycling); among India's largest private highway operators by toll collection.

ITC.desc: Diversified conglomerate. Cigarettes — market leader through Gold Flake, Classic, Wills, Navy Cut — drives the bulk of profit, while a growing FMCG portfolio (Aashirvaad atta, Sunfeast biscuits, Bingo snacks, Yippee noodles, Vivel and Mangaldeep) plus hotels (ITC and Welcomhotel — being demerged), paperboards and agribusiness verticals diversify the franchise.

JK Cement.desc: Singhania-promoted cement maker. Strong in grey cement across Northern and Central India and India's leader in white cement and wall putty (JK Wall Putty); growing presence in tile adhesives, waterproofing and paints.

JSW Cement.desc: JSW Group's cement business. Operates the world's largest GGBS-based (slag-from-JSW-Steel) green-cement platform alongside clinker plants in South and East India; emphasis on low-carbon cement and a net-zero pathway.

JSW Steel.desc: JSW Group's flagship integrated steel maker. India's #2 steel producer with capacity at Vijayanagar, Dolvi and Salem domestically and overseas assets in the US and Italy; growing value-added mix in automotive grades and downstream coated lines.

Jubilant FoodWorks.desc: India's largest master-franchisee of Domino's Pizza (1,900+ outlets) and Dunkin' Donuts; also operates Popeyes chicken QSR and the in-house Hong's Kitchen Chinese QSR brand. Pivoting toward an integrated digital-first food-tech platform.

Jubilant Ingrevia.desc: Specialty-chemicals and life-science ingredients company. Pyridine and pyridine-derivatives leader plus life-science chemicals, nutrition ingredients and health solutions; serves pharma, agrochemicals and food customers globally.

Jupiter Wagons.desc: Railway-wagon and rolling-stock manufacturer. Makes freight wagons for Indian Railways, brake systems and rail components; also runs a small commercial-vehicle business (Jupiter Tatra Trucks) and is building EV-mobility products.

Kotak Mahindra Bank.desc: Uday Kotak-founded private-sector bank. Universal-banking franchise spanning retail and corporate lending, deposits and treasury, supported by a strong asset-management arm (Kotak Mahindra AMC), Kotak Life Insurance, Kotak General Insurance, Kotak Securities and Kotak Investment Banking.

L&T.desc: India's largest infrastructure-EPC conglomerate. Executes heavy civil infrastructure (transport, water, hydrocarbon, power), defence platforms and heavy engineering; also operates IT services (via LTIMindtree and LTTS), financial services (L&T Finance) and minerals/manufacturing arms.

L&T Finance.desc: L&T Group's diversified NBFC. Lending focused on rural (farm equipment, two-wheeler, micro-finance), urban (consumer loans, home loans, SME) and SME finance; pivoting to a fully retailised lending franchise.

Larsen & Toubro.desc: India's largest infrastructure-EPC conglomerate. Builds heavy civil infrastructure (transport, water, hydrocarbon, power), defence platforms and heavy engineering; also runs IT services (LTIMindtree, LTTS), financial services (L&T Finance) and minerals/manufacturing arms.

Lemon Tree Hotels.desc: Mid-market hotel chain. Operates Lemon Tree (upper-mid), Red Fox (mid), Lemon Tree Premier and Aurika (upscale) brands across 90+ properties in India; owned, leased, managed and franchised inventory mix.

LIC India.desc: India's largest life insurer (government-owned majority). Pan-India distribution anchored by an agency force of 1.3 million+; participating, non-participating, ULIP and group business across individual and group life. Holds one of the largest equity portfolios in listed Indian companies.

Lloyds Metals and Energy.desc: Iron-ore mining and sponge-iron producer. Operates the Surjagarh iron-ore mine in Maharashtra with growing capacity; expanding both backward (mining) and forward (long-products steel via under-construction integrated facilities) into the value chain.

LTIMindtree.desc: L&T-Infotech + Mindtree merged IT-services major (L&T Group). Digital transformation, cloud, data and AI services with deep verticals in BFSI, technology-media-telecom, manufacturing and retail.

Marico.desc: Branded FMCG company. Anchored by Parachute coconut oil (market leader) and Saffola (refined edible oils, breakfast and masala oats), with a growing personal-care portfolio (Beardo, Just Herbs, Plix, Pure Sense) and a sizeable international business (Bangladesh, Vietnam, MENA).

Max Healthcare.desc: Private hospital chain. Operates 22+ hospitals across North India (Saket, Patparganj, Vaishali, Mohali, Dehradun) and a growing presence in Mumbai; tertiary-care programmes in oncology, cardiac sciences, orthopaedics and minimal-access surgery.

Metro Brands.desc: Branded footwear retailer. Operates Metro Shoes, Mochi, Walkway, Crocs (master franchise), Da Vinchi, Fila and FitFlop stores across India; multi-brand-outlet (MBO) format anchored in premium and aspirational segments.

Mphasis.desc: Blackstone-controlled IT-services major. Specialises in BFSI (banking, capital markets, insurance) with a growing cloud, customer-experience and applied-AI services offering; close partnership with hyperscalers.

Narayana Hrudayalaya.desc: Bengaluru-headquartered hospital chain. Originally a cardiac-care specialist, today operates 22+ multispecialty hospitals across India and the Cayman Islands; known for high-volume, low-cost tertiary care across cardiology, oncology and neurosciences.

Navin Fluorine.desc: Fluorine-chemistry specialist. Operates inorganic fluorides, refrigerant gases and specialty fluorochemicals businesses, with a fast-growing high-value contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) franchise serving global pharma and agrochemical innovators.

NMDC.desc: India's largest iron-ore miner (government-owned). Operates large-scale mines at Bailadila (Chhattisgarh) and Donimalai (Karnataka), supplying domestic steel majors; an under-construction integrated steel plant at Nagarnar is being demerged.

NTPC.desc: India's largest power-generation company (government-owned). Coal-fired thermal generation forms the backbone, with a growing renewables platform housed in separately listed NTPC Green Energy alongside gas, hydro and nuclear capacity. Major beneficiary of India's power-demand cycle and the energy transition.

Oil and Natural Gas.desc: Government-owned ONGC — India's largest upstream oil and gas producer. Operates crude-oil and natural-gas blocks across western offshore (Mumbai High), eastern offshore (KG-DWN) and onshore; ONGC Videsh runs the international E&P portfolio.

Oil India.desc: Government-owned upstream oil and gas company. Produces crude oil and natural gas, primarily from Assam and Rajasthan; also runs an LPG plant and holds a controlling stake in the Numaligarh refinery (NRL).

Ola Electric.desc: Ola Group EV two-wheeler manufacturer. Designs and builds the Ola S1 family of electric scooters at its Futurefactory in Tamil Nadu; building battery-cell manufacturing under the Bharat Cell programme and developing an electric motorcycle platform.

One 97 Communications.desc: Operator of Paytm — India's home-grown payments and financial-services platform. Consumer payments (UPI, wallet, bills), merchant payments (QR, Soundbox, EDC), distribution of credit (loan-marketplace model) and wealth-tech; restructured following the Paytm Payments Bank wind-down.

ONGC.desc: Government-owned upstream oil and gas major. India's largest crude-oil and natural-gas producer with assets in western offshore (Mumbai High), eastern offshore (KG-DWN) and a wide onshore footprint; ONGC Videsh handles the international E&P portfolio.

Page Industries.desc: Exclusive licensee of Jockey (innerwear) and Speedo (swimwear) in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal and the UAE. Dominant share in branded men's innerwear, with a growing women's and athleisure portfolio.

Patanjali Foods.desc: Ramdev-backed FMCG and edible-oils company (formerly Ruchi Soya). Operates Patanjali-branded foods, edible oils (Nutrela, Mahakosh, Ruchi Gold), nutraceuticals and a small home & personal-care business; the largest player in Indian soya nutrition through Nutrela.

PI Industries.desc: Agrochemical custom-synthesis-manufacturing (CSM) specialist. Contract-manufactures patented agrochemical molecules for global innovators (Syngenta, Bayer, BASF and others), alongside an in-licensed domestic agrochemical-products portfolio; expanding into pharma CSM through subsidiary acquisitions.

Praj Industries.desc: Bioenergy and process-engineering company. Designs and builds ethanol plants (first-generation, second-generation and biofuels), water/wastewater treatment systems and process equipment for breweries, pharma and chemicals; among India's leading ethanol-plant integrators.

Prestige Estates Projects.desc: Bengaluru-headquartered real-estate developer. Operates residential, office, retail-mall (Forum) and hospitality (Conrad, JW Marriott) developments across South India, Mumbai and NCR; one of India's top residential developers by booking value.

Rainbow Children's Hospitals.desc: Hyderabad-headquartered paediatric and women's hospital chain. Operates 17+ multispecialty paediatric and perinatal hospitals primarily in South India; tertiary-care focus on neonatal intensive care, paediatric oncology and foetal medicine.

Rainbow Children's Medicare.desc: Hyderabad-headquartered paediatric and women's hospital chain. Operates 17+ multispecialty paediatric and perinatal hospitals primarily in South India; tertiary-care focus on neonatal intensive care, paediatric oncology and foetal medicine.

RateGain.desc: Travel-tech SaaS company. Provides distribution, revenue management, rate intelligence and pricing analytics solutions to hotels, airlines, car-rental companies and OTAs globally; subscription-led SaaS revenue model.

Reliance Industries.desc: Mukesh Ambani-led conglomerate. Oil-to-chemicals (the world's largest single-site refinery at Jamnagar plus petrochemicals), digital services (Jio — India's #1 telecom plus JioFiber and JioAirFiber), retail (Reliance Retail — India's largest retailer across grocery, fashion, electronics, jewellery and pharmacy) and a new-energy platform (giga-factories for solar, batteries, electrolysers and fuel cells). Also runs media (Network18, the JioStar JV) and an upstream oil & gas business.

SAMHI Hotels.desc: Branded mid-market hotel platform. Owns ~30 hotels operated under Marriott, Hyatt and IHG brands across India's top business cities; consolidator of branded mid-market inventory.

Samvardhana Motherson.desc: Global auto-components supplier. India's largest auto-components company by revenue; supplies wiring harnesses, vision systems (mirrors, lighting), polymer modules and aerospace components to global OEMs across 40+ countries.

Sansera Engineering.desc: Precision-forged-components specialist. Manufactures connecting rods, rocker arms, crankshafts and aluminium forged parts for two-wheeler, passenger-vehicle, commercial-vehicle and aerospace OEMs in India and globally.

Shyam Metalics & Energy.desc: Kolkata-headquartered integrated long-product steel producer. Manufactures sponge iron, billets, structurals, wire rods, TMT bars, ferro alloys and aluminium foils; moving up the value chain into stainless steel and specialty products.

Siemens Limited.desc: Indian subsidiary of Siemens AG (Germany). Industrial automation, drives, smart infrastructure (buildings, low-voltage power) and mobility (rail rolling stock, signalling); the energy assets have been carved out into separately listed Siemens Energy India.

State Bank of India.desc: India's largest commercial bank (government-owned). Universal-banking franchise across retail, corporate, international and treasury; major subsidiaries in life insurance (SBI Life), asset management (SBI Mutual Fund), credit cards (SBI Cards) and capital markets (SBI Caps).

Sterlite Tech.desc: Optical-fibre and digital-networks company. Manufactures optical fibre (preform-to-cable integrated), data-centre cabling and network solutions; serves telecom operators, hyperscalers and government broadband programmes.

Sun Pharmaceuticals.desc: India's largest pharma company. Strong specialty/branded pharma franchise globally (Ilumya in psoriasis, Cequa in dry eye, Winlevi in dermatology); #1 in Indian formulations and a top-three generics player in the US.

Sun TV Network.desc: South-Indian broadcaster. Operates 30+ regional channels across Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Bengali, alongside an OTT play (Sun NXT) and an IPL franchise (Sunrisers Hyderabad).

Tata Comm.desc: Tata Communications — a global telecom and digital-services major. Operates one of the world's largest tier-1 wholesale-IP backbones and undersea-cable networks, enterprise managed-network and unified-communications services, plus growing media-services and IoT verticals.

Tata Consumer Products.desc: Tata Group's FMCG flagship. Branded tea (Tata Tea, Tetley — world's #2), coffee (Tata Coffee), salt (Tata Salt — market leader), pulses (Tata Sampann) and a growing branded-foods portfolio (8 PM, Soulfull, Ching's Secret); also runs the Starbucks JV in India.

Tata Motors.desc: Tata Group automobile flagship. Commercial-vehicles market leader in India (heavy/medium trucks, buses, LCVs), passenger-vehicles franchise built on Nexon, Punch, Harrier, Safari and a growing EV portfolio (Nexon EV, Punch EV, Tigor EV), plus the global luxury arm Jaguar Land Rover.

TBO Tek.desc: Global travel-distribution platform. B2B platform connecting global travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, tour operators, transfers) with 150,000+ travel buyers across 100+ countries.

TCI Express.desc: Express-logistics company. Surface express transportation for B2B small and large parcels across India; asset-light hub-and-spoke network with a dedicated fleet, partner trucks and centralised sorting hubs.

TeamLease Services.desc: Staffing and HR-services major. India's largest temp-staffing platform serving 6,500+ employers across IT, ITeS, BFSI, retail and manufacturing; also runs degree-apprenticeship, payroll, training and skilling businesses.

The Ramco Cement.desc: South-Indian cement major (Ramco Group). Strong dealer-led brand position in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Kerala, expanding into Eastern India; product range covers grey cement, blended cement, ready-mix concrete and dry-mortar products.

Titagarh.desc: Titagarh Rail Systems — railway-wagon, rolling-stock and metro-rail-coach manufacturer. Among India's largest private wagon makers, building metro trainsets (Pune, Surat, Ahmedabad) and Vande Bharat rake supplies; also runs a small shipbuilding business.

Torrent Pharmaceuticals.desc: Torrent Group's domestic-formulation pharma flagship. Strong franchises in cardiovascular, central-nervous-system and gastrointestinal therapies in India; growing presence in Brazil, the US and Germany.

TTK Prestige.desc: TTK Group's branded kitchenware company. India's #1 pressure-cooker brand (Prestige) alongside cookware, kitchen appliances (mixer grinders, induction cooktops) and modular kitchens. Strong dealer network and exclusive-brand outlets.

Varroc Engineering.desc: Auto-components supplier. Makes lighting (head/tail/fog lamps), electrical-electronics and polymer modules for two-wheelers and four-wheelers; sold the four-wheeler lighting business to Plastic Omnium (2022) to focus on two-wheeler lighting.

Varun Beverages.desc: PepsiCo's largest franchise bottler outside the United States. Bottles and distributes Pepsi, 7Up, Mountain Dew, Mirinda, Sting, Aquafina and Tropicana across India (most of the country), Sri Lanka, Nepal, Morocco, Zambia, Zimbabwe and DRC.

Vinati Organics.desc: Specialty-chemicals producer. World's largest manufacturer of ATBS (acrylamido tertiary butyl sulphonic acid — for water treatment, EOR, personal care) and IBB (a paracetamol intermediate); growing portfolio in butyl phenols and antioxidants.

Welspun Living.desc: Welspun Group's home-textiles major. Among the world's largest manufacturers of terry towels and bed linen, supplying global retailers (Walmart, Target, Macy's) under private labels alongside own brands (Welspun, Spaces) in India.

Whirlpool of India.desc: Indian subsidiary of Whirlpool Corporation (US). Manufactures refrigerators, washing machines, microwaves and air conditioners under the Whirlpool brand; strong share in single-door refrigerators and semi-automatic washing machines.
